answer_1.quote: We propose a novel Adversarial Tuning Multi‑agent system (ATM) to improve the robustness and capabilities of the retrieval‑augmented GENERATOR, which writes high‑quality answers for given questions.

answer_2.quote: We adopt strict Exact Match (EM) metric ... we also report the Subspan EM and F1 as additional metrics to balance between the correctness and comprehensiveness of answers.
